verdict.rationale: Twenty documents a fast self-serve path: a cloud workspace spins up in under a minute, CSV/XLSX import includes field mapping, duplicate detection and in-UI error fixing, and kanban boards give a pipeline view. One community user called setup 'extremely easy', but also hit several small alpha-stage issues. Nothing evidences the full signup-to-working-pipeline journey in under an hour, and relational imports require referencing unique fields such as id, email or domain, which adds friction. Missing for 10: end-to-end evidence of reaching a working pipeline with real data within an hour, a guided onboarding or pipeline template/wizard, and independent hands-on corroboration of a self-serve migration without outside help.

support.subject: As a founder, I can go from signup to a working pipeline with my real data in under an hour, without an implementation partner

citations.quote: Sign up at twenty.com and spin up a workspace in under a minute, with no infrastructure to manage and always up to date.
Field mapping, duplicate detection, and error handling built in.
Review errors (highlighted in yellow) and fix them, directly editing in the UI
Switch between table views, kanban boards, and calendar views.
It was extremely easy to set up
